chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Sa'dan, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

You should say during every night of the month of Ramadan, at the time of breaking the fast until its end: 'All praise is for Allah, Who aided us so we fasted, and provided for us so we broke the fast. O Allah, accept from us, aid us in it, grant us safety in it, and receive it from us with ease and well-being from You. All praise is for Allah, Who has decreed for us one day from the month of Ramadan.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite when breaking the fast during Ramadan?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this supplication emphasizes the dual blessings of divine enablement (tawfiq) and sustenance (rizq) required for fasting, reflecting the Shia emphasis on gratitude for both the act and the capacity to perform it. The phrase 'He has discharged a day for us' highlights the completion of the obligatory duty, while the request for 'ease' and 'health' underscores the holistic nature of worship in Shia tradition, linking spiritual acceptance with physical well-being.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Sa’dan, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘One should be saying during every night from the Month of Ramazan, during the breaking of the Fast up to its end, ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Who Aided us, so we Fasted, and Graced us, so we broke. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Accept from us, and Aid us upon it, and Secure us in it, and Receive is from us in ease from You<sup>azwj</sup> and good health. The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Who Accomplished for us one day from the Month of Ramazan’.
en.sarwar: 2. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Sa‘dan from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

every night in the month of Ramadan during breakfast after sunset, say this prayer, ‘All praise belongs to Allah who has helped us to fast and has granted us sustenance to break our fast. O Allah, accept it from us and help us to do it, keep us safe in this month, receive it from us with ease from You and good health. All praise belongs to Allah who completed one day of the month of Ramadan for us.”’
